chars.NARRATOR: a 19-year-old Moroccan young man with short curly black hair and light stubble, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie and black joggers
chars.GIRLFRIEND: a 19-year-old Moroccan young woman with long wavy dark-brown hair, wearing a lilac oversized denim jacket over a white top and light-blue jeans
chars.NEWGUY: a stylish Moroccan young man with a neat fade haircut, wearing a black leather jacket, white t-shirt and a silver watch

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Seen from across a street through a cafe window in Settat, Morocco: GIRLFRIEND laughs loudly at a cafe terrace table while NEWGUY leans in close telling her a joke. Head-to-waist framing, both faces clearly visible, she looks delighted. Calm blurred street at the edges. Flat 2D cartoon illustration.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: GIRLFRIEND and NEWGUY taking a selfie next to a shiny new car in front of a modern Settat university building, she poses excitedly, he holds an expensive phone. Faces visible in the centre of the frame. Flat 2D cartoon illustration.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR sits alone on a worn sofa in a small modest Casablanca room, scrolling his phone with a hurt, jealous face, the screen glow lighting him. Face visible, centred. Flat 2D cartoon illustration.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Night: NARRATOR lies awake in bed staring at the ceiling, eyes wide and worried, a faint dreamy cloud above him shows a blurred silhouette of a couple holding hands. Face visible in the centre. Flat 2D cartoon illustration, no text.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Dreamlike imagined scene in soft purple tones: GIRLFRIEND walking arm in arm with NEWGUY down a lively Settat street at sunset, both smiling at each other. Faces visible in the centre. Flat 2D cartoon illustration.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR stands in his room holding his phone up, frustrated and confused, staring at a chat with no reply (only blank grey bubbles, no readable text). Face visible, centred. Flat 2D cartoon illustration.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: GIRLFRIEND at a cluttered student desk piled with books in a dorm room, on a video call on her laptop, waving her hand dismissively and looking away busy and annoyed. Face visible in the centre. Flat 2D cartoon illustration.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR paces in his small room talking angrily on the phone, one hand raised in frustration, eyebrows furrowed, tense mood. Face visible, centred. Flat 2D cartoon illustration.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Close-up waist-up: NARRATOR holds the phone to his ear, frozen in shock with mouth open as the call suddenly cuts off, red call-ended glow on the phone. Face visible in the centre. Flat 2D cartoon illustration.
